tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Public booking page for a provider slug: name, headline, time zone, currency, services, upcoming group sessions, and the booking URL. No client data.

tools.name: find_open_slots
tools.description: Open start times for a public service, using the same slot rules as the booking page. from_date and to_date are YYYY-MM-DD and at most 31 days apart. Each start is ISO 8601 with the provider's offset, plus a provider-local label.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Check that a start is still open, then return a link to the booking page with that service and time selected. The client confirms and pays on Appty. Nothing is booked here.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: This provider's bookings. Omit from and to for upcoming sessions. Never includes pay or manage tokens.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: This provider's clients: id, name, email, phone, billing currency, and default pay mode.

tools.name: who_owes
tools.description: Unpaid balances for this provider, grouped by client and currency. Same figures as the dashboard who-owes page.

tools.name: book_session
tools.description: Book a client into a service at a start time, the same way the dashboard books. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. A past start is saved as completed with no email. A future start emails the usual confirmation. No money moves through the assistant. Any pay link is only a reques

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Move a booking to an open slot. The client is not emailed. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking under the provider's cancellation policy and email the client. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant. Any refund or fee is applied by Appty, the same as the dashboard. The client pays anything still due on Appty.

tools.name: send_pay_link
tools.description: Email a pay link for one booking, or for a client's unpaid sessions and invoices. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant. This only sends a request the client pays on Appty. Group spots, packages, and fees are not emailed.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Create one invoice per currency for a client's sessions (by id or by calendar month) and email it. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant. The invoice only sends a request the client pays on Appty.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_provider, list_clients · Private data: list_bookings · Public sink: list_clients, book_session, cancel_booking, send_pay_link, send_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_provider, list_clients · Private data: list_bookings · Public sink: list_clients, book_session, cancel_booking, send_pay_link, send_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
